data.statement: Evidence-binding correction for evt-20260828-v6-product-preflight: the candidate record durably identifies the exact Amazon listing, canonical destination, and inspected local source image for ASIN B0G9M9XPSX. Those candidate-specific references, rather than the experiment-created event, support the product identity and source-image claims.
data.decision: Treat evt-20260828-v6-raw-chicken-created as the causal product/source verification evidence for this candidate and preserve the earlier event as append-only history.
data.nextAction: Require future product-preflight learnings to cite a prior candidate-specific listing and source-reference event before they make listing or object-identity claims.
